Map a Base R type argument onto a MAIDR step direction

Source: R/base_r_adapter.R
base_r_step_direction.Rd

type = "s" draws the horizontal segment first, which is MAIDR's "hv"; type = "S" draws the vertical segment first, which is "vh". Any other value returns NULL so the caller can omit stepDirection rather than assert a convention the call never asked for.

Usage

base_r_step_direction(plot_type)

Arguments

plot_type

The type argument recorded from the plot call.

Value

"hv", "vh", or NULL.
